sections.title: Synopsis
sections.markdown: Physical DPS that specializes in single-target damage. Prefers to stay in one spot to accumulate stacking buffs.

upgrades.description: Additional critical damage and enhanced stability index ignore based on target's Analysis Score.
Enhances Bullseye: more defense reduction and Analytical Score is no longer consumed on hit.
Adds stacking attack buff while Mimosa's Calyx is active.
Enhances Deliberate Action and adds a stacking buff that increases the damage multiplier of Ultimate.

sections.title: Team notes
sections.markdown: Needs Yoohee for the Reversed Assault buff. Other than that, the two of them can flex in as a package in a mixed composition. Mono-physical teams or teams with additional defense reduction sources work too.

sections.title: Build notes
sections.markdown: Physical DPS - attack, critical. All damage is single-target so look for single-target boosts in her Remolding Pattern - Pinpoint Specialization, Precision Blow.
